description.value: Special quality listed in the source statblock: Quick Learner (Weapon Focus [Longsword]).

The elementals know that the Vanu Vanu are more susceptible to attacks from foreign races and monster and grant them their wind ability. Once per day, as a swift action, a vanu can grant himself a +2 deflection bonus to AC against ranged attacks for 1 minute.

effect: For one minute gain +2 deflection against ranged attacks only.

description.value: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks, and they learn one additional language every time they put a rank in the Linguistics skill.

contextNotes.text: +1 racial Bluff and Diplomacy already in totals; one extra language per Linguistics rank.

description.value: Vanu gain a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls, a +2 dodge bonus to AC, and a +2 bonus on Perception checks against flying creatures. In addition, enemies on higher ground gain no attack roll bonus against vanu.

contextNotes.text: +1 attacks, +2 dodge AC, +2 Perception vs flying creatures; higher ground grants enemies no attack bonus.

description.value: Only against ranged attacks, +2 deflection to AC.
Enable only for this flying opponent; disable before resolving others.
Spell Combat

effect: Free hand required. Cast one standard-action spell and take -2 on attacks.

description.value: Spellstrike

effect: Deliver one qualifying touch spell through a successful weapon hit. Resolve the spell only once.

description.value: Quick Cast

effect: Cast a known standard-action or faster spell as a swift action. The printed base use is 1/day; the separate bonus use is on Red Magery.

description.value: Convert

effect: Spend 5 HP per MP recovered (maximum 4 MP); cannot drop below 1 HP.

description.value: Arcane Pool

effect: Spend one point; enhance one held weapon by +1 for one minute.
Spend one point from this same pool; activate Spell Shield until end of next turn.
